sql:
with o as (
  select lo.id, lo.kalshi_order_id, lo.market_ticker, lo.created_at, lo.limit_price, lo.status, lo.cancel_reason
  from live_orders lo
  where lo.strategy = 'Fmmsell10' and lo.side = 'no' and lo.action = 'buy' and lo.kalshi_order_id is not null
    and lo.created_at >= '2026-09-16T00:00:00Z'
), fe as (
  select kalshi_order_id, min(ts_ms) f_ms, string_agg(trade_id, '|') tids, sum(count_fp) q
  from execution_fill_events where kalshi_order_id in (select kalshi_order_id from o) group by 1
), s as (
  select market_ticker, max(case when side = 'no' then resolved_value else 100 - resolved_value end) settle_no
  from paper_trades where resolved_value is not null and strategy like '%mmsell%'
    and market_ticker in (select market_ticker from o) group by 1
)
select o.id, o.market_ticker, (extract(epoch from o.created_at) * 1000)::bigint c_ms, o.limit_price,
       coalesce(o.cancel_reason, o.status) st, fe.f_ms, fe.q, s.settle_no, fe.tids
from o left join fe using (kalshi_order_id) left join s using (market_ticker) order by o.created_at
